Requirements Please keep in mind, Snorkeling the Reef requires some Snorkeling Experience and that Snorkeling is a Very Physical Activity and you Must be able to Swim to get in the water.
Also, you Must be Physically Able to Climb Boat Ladder in possibly 1 to 3 ft seas.
Swimming in the ocean, you may encounter currents and swells which require the ability to swim and float confidently.
Children Must be accompanied by a legal guardian.
If you can’t swim good, don’t snorkel.
Beware of drifting away, swim back to boat.
